timeline.label: Q3 FY2026 nine-month revenue reached $5.07B (+19% YoY); stockholders equity rose to $10.7B reflecting preferred conversion and strong equity marks
FY2025 revenue $5.81B (+23% YoY) but net income fell to $49M from $156M as integration amortization and costs weighed on reported earnings
FY2025 normalized owner cash was $193M ($0.99/sh) after $441M capital spending on a $634M operating cash flow base
Completed merger with Coherent Inc.; II-VI renamed Coherent Corp. and issued Series B-2 convertible preferred to Bain-related BCPE Watson for deal financing
Entered senior credit facilities and repaid legacy II-VI and Coherent debt; leverage from Coherent acquisition remains on balance sheet
Announced agreement to acquire Coherent Inc., combining II-VI materials/networking/lasers platform with Coherent laser and photonics portfolio

industry.structure: Photonics and compound-semiconductor components for datacom, industrial lasers, and precision materials is oligopolistic at the high end (Coherent, Lumentum, II-VI legacy peers) but cyclical and capital-intensive. Vertical integration in materials and optics creates scale barriers; customer concentration in hyperscaler and telecom OEMs limits pricing power.
industry.share_shift: Coherent gained scale via the 2022 Coherent Inc. merger and is benefiting from AI-driven datacom transceiver and optical interconnect demand, but reported net income compressed in FY2025 despite revenue growth as integration costs and amortization persist.
industry.trend: Hyperscaler AI build-out is raising demand for high-speed optical components (800G/1.6T), while industrial and consumer end markets remain cyclical. Heavy capital spending and merger-related debt keep normalized owner cash well below headline revenue growth and equity market capitalization.
